title: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
description:
1. Select a manageable load, clear the area, and take a stable starting position for Kettlebell Goblet Squat.
2. Hold the bell close to the chest, squat between the hips with the knees tracking over the toes, then drive through the feet to stand.
3. Return the load under control and repeat for the programmed repetitions.
